title: A counterexample to Kaplansky’s zero-divisor conjecture

result.label: A counterexample to Kaplansky’s zero-divisor conjecture
result.statement: Constructs a finitely presented torsion-free group G whose group algebra F2[G] has nonzero zero divisors, disproving Kaplansky's zero-divisor conjecture. The group has a finite two-dimensional classifying space.
